evals.prompt: Setup Workload Identity Federation (WIF) between GitLab CI/CD and GCP to eliminate long-lived service account keys in Terraform.
evals.expected_output: Terraform configuration declaring google_iam_workload_identity_pool and provider for GitLab, binding an IAM service account, and a .gitlab-ci.yml using id_tokens.
assertions: Eliminates static JSON service account keys in favor of short-lived OIDC tokens
Configures google_iam_workload_identity_pool and pool provider for GitLab
Binds the workload identity pool to the target GCP service account
Includes GitLab CI job configuration specifying id_tokens with audience

evals.prompt: Create a modular Terraform configuration and GitLab CI pipeline to deploy a containerized service to Google Cloud Run.
evals.expected_output: Terraform files (main.tf, variables.tf) for google_cloud_run_v2_service and a .gitlab-ci.yml with validate, plan, and apply stages.
assertions: Defines Cloud Run service resource with parameterized image and environment variables
Configures GCS remote backend for Terraform state
Defines standard CI/CD stages (validate, plan, apply)
